source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 27 (PDF 160-177), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 27 (Biochemistry) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define biochemistry. Name four functional groups found in biological compounds.
(Biochemistry ki tareef karein. Biological compounds mein paye jane wale chaar functional groups ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Biochemistry science ki woh shaakh hai jo zinda organisms ke chemical substances aur un ke reactions ka mutaala karti hai. Biological compounds mein saade organic compounds wale functional groups hote hain, misaal alcohol, amine, aldehyde, ketone (aur carboxylic acid, ester, amide).

book_ref.quote: such as alcohol, amine, aldehyde, ketone, carboxylic acid, ester, and amide groups

blocks.prompt:
2 What are carbohydrates? Give their chemical definition.
(Carbohydrates kya hain? Un ki chemical tareef likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Carbohydrates qudrati organic compounds hain jin mein sugars, starch, cellulose aur bacteria ki cell walls aur insects ke exoskeletons ke substances shamil hain; yeh hamari khurak mein energy ka bara zariya hain. Chemical tor par yeh polyhydroxy aldehydes ya ketones ya un se bane compounds hain.

book_ref.quote: These act as major sources of energy in our diet.

blocks.prompt:
3 What are monosaccharides? Write their general formula and give two examples.
(Monosaccharides kya hain? Un ka general formula aur do misaalein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Monosaccharides sab se saade carbohydrates (sugars) hain jo mazeed saade compounds mein hydrolyse nahi hote. General formula Cₙ(H₂O)y, jahan n = 3 se 7. Misaalein: glucose aur fructose.

book_ref.quote: Monosaccharides are the simplest carbohydrates commonly known as sugars

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki misaal mein 'sucrose' likha hai, magar sucrose disaccharide hai (book correction). Monosaccharide ki sahi misaalein glucose aur fructose hain.

blocks.prompt:
4 How are monosaccharides named according to the number of carbon atoms?
(Carbon atoms ki tadaad ke lehaaz se monosaccharides ke naam kaise rakhe jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Teen carbon atoms: triose; chaar: tetrose; paanch: pentose; chhe: hexose, waghera.

book_ref.quote: A monosaccharide with three carbon atoms is a triose

blocks.prompt:
5 Differentiate between an aldose and a ketose.
(Aldose aur ketose mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Aldose aur Ketose ka muqabla, nukta ba nukta:

book_ref.quote: They are also classified according to the functional group present

blocks.prompt:
6 Differentiate between a furanose ring and a pyranose ring.
(Furanose ring aur pyranose ring mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Furanose aur Pyranose ka muqabla, nukta ba nukta:

book_ref.quote: The linear chain and cyclic structures are interconvertible.

blocks.prompt:
7 Why are pure monosaccharides solids and yet highly soluble in water?
(Khalis monosaccharides solid kyun hain aur phir bhi paani mein bohat hal kyun hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Un ke bohat se –OH groups molecules ke darmiyan ziyada hydrogen bonds banate hain, is liye woh solid hain. Paani mein yahi –OH groups paani ke molecules se hydrogen bonds banate hain, is liye woh bohat hal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: For this reason, monosaccharides exist in solid form in their pure form.

blocks.prompt:
8 Why is honey thick and viscous?
(Shehad gaarha aur viscous (gaarha behne wala) kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Shehad mein glucose aur fructose ziyada miqdaar mein hain. Un ke –OH groups ki mazboot hydrogen bonding shehad ko gaarha aur viscous banati hai.

book_ref.quote: Fructose and glucose are present in honey in high concentrations.

blocks.prompt:
9 Why is glucose called blood sugar? Where is fructose abundant?
(Glucose ko blood sugar kyun kehte hain? Fructose kahan ziyada milta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glucose insani khoon mein maujood hone ki wajah se blood sugar kehlati hai; yeh doosre monosaccharides ki tarah foran energy ka behtareen zariya hai. Fructose phalon aur shehad mein ziyada hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Monosaccharides are excellent source of instant energy in the living organisms.

blocks.prompt:
10 What are disaccharides? How are they formed?
(Disaccharides kya hain? Yeh kaise bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Disaccharides do monosaccharide units se bane hain jo glycosidic linkage se jude hote hain (general formula C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁). Yeh condensation reaction se bante hain: aik monosaccharide ka –OH doosre ke hydrogen se mil kar paani ka aik molecule nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: They are formed through a condensation reaction

blocks.prompt:
11 What is a glycosidic bond? Name the units of sucrose.
(Glycosidic bond kya hai? Sucrose kin units se bana hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do monosaccharide units ko jodne wala C–O–C bond (jo paani nikalne se banta hai) glycosidic bond hai. Sucrose, aam cheeni, glucose aur fructose ka disaccharide hai.

book_ref.quote: For example, sucrose which is a common table sugar

blocks.prompt:
12 Show by an equation that two hexoses C₆H₁₂O₆ give a disaccharide of formula C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁. Name three common disaccharides.
(Equation se dikhayein ke do hexoses C₆H₁₂O₆ mil kar C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁ disaccharide dete hain. Teen aam disaccharides ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: C₆H₁₂O₆ + C₆H₁₂O₆ → C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁ + H₂O (condensation: C₁₂H₂₄O₁₂ – H₂O = C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁). Aam disaccharides: sucrose, lactose aur maltose.

book_ref.quote: Among the most common disaccharides are sucrose, lactose and maltose.

blocks.prompt:
13 Define polysaccharides. Give their general formula and four examples.
(Polysaccharides ki tareef karein. Un ka general formula aur chaar misaalein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Polysaccharides ziyada molecular mass wale bade molecules hain jo bohat se monosaccharide units ke judne se bante hain; hydrolysis par monosaccharides dete hain. General formula (C₆H₁₀O₅)ₙ. Misaalein: starch, glycogen, cellulose aur pectin.

book_ref.quote: They have high molecular mass

blocks.prompt:
14 Differentiate between amylose and amylopectin on the basis of structure.
(Banawat ki bunyaad par amylose aur amylopectin mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Amylose aur Amylopectin ka muqabla, nukta ba nukta:

book_ref.quote: While amylopectin is a compact highly branched structure

rows: Seedhi chain mein bohat glycosidic linkages
Shaakhon wali chains mein bohat glucose units

blocks.prompt:
15 Compare glycogen with amylopectin.
(Glycogen ka amylopectin se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Glycogen aur Amylopectin ka muqabla, nukta ba nukta:

book_ref.quote: The structure of glycogen is very similar to that of amylopectin

rows: Animal starch, liver aur muscles mein jama
Shaakhon wala magar glycogen se kam

blocks.prompt:
16 Why is cellulose rigid and insoluble in water?
(Cellulose sakht aur paani mein na-hal kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cellulose glucose units ki lambi be-shaakh chains se bana hai jo glycosidic bonds se judi hain. Yeh chains aapas mein mazboot hydrogen bonds banati hain, is liye cellulose sakht aur paani mein na-hal hai.

book_ref.quote: These chains form strong hydrogen bonds with each other

blocks.prompt:
17 Where is cellulose found and why is it important in human food?
(Cellulose kahan paya jata hai aur insani khurak mein ahem kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cellulose paudon ki cell walls ka bara structural maadda hai aur pattiyon, shaakhon aur tane ka bara hissa hai. Insani khurak mein yeh fibre ke tor par ahem hai jo aanton ki sehat behtar karta hai.

book_ref.quote: which improves the gut health

blocks.prompt:
18 A polysaccharide (C₆H₁₀O₅)ₙ has molar mass 32 400 g mol⁻¹. Find n (C = 12, H = 1, O = 16).
(Aik polysaccharide (C₆H₁₀O₅)ₙ ka molar mass 32 400 g mol⁻¹ hai. n maloom karein (C = 12, H = 1, O = 16).)
blocks.explanation: Aik unit C₆H₁₀O₅ ka mass = 6(12) + 10(1) + 5(16) = 162 g mol⁻¹. n = 32 400 ÷ 162 = 200.

book_ref.quote: Common examples are starch, glycogen, cellulose and pectin.

blocks.prompt:
19 1 g of glucose provides about 15.6 kJ. How much energy do 40 g of glucose provide?
(1 g glucose taqreeban 15.6 kJ deta hai. 40 g glucose kitni energy denge?)
blocks.explanation: Energy = 40 g × 15.6 kJ g⁻¹ = 624 kJ.

book_ref.quote: Simple sugars like glucose are the primary source of energy for cells.

blocks.prompt:
20 What is the normal blood glucose level? Which hormones control it?
(Khoon mein glucose ki normal miqdaar kya hai? Kaun se hormones ise control karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aam tor par blood glucose 70-110 mg/dL hota hai, agarche din mein thoda oopar neeche hota hai. Ise insulin aur glucagon hormones control karte hain.

book_ref.quote: though it may fluctuate slightly during the day

blocks.prompt:
21 What is diabetes?
(Diabetes kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab blood glucose normal had se barh jaye to diabetes ho sakti hai; yeh daaimi (chronic) haalat hai jab pancreas kaafi insulin nahi banata ya jism banaye gaye insulin ko theek istemal nahi kar pata.

book_ref.quote: a chronic condition that occurs when the pancreas does not produce enough insulin

blocks.prompt:
22 What is hyperglycemia? What harm does it cause?
(Hyperglycemia kya hai? Yeh kya nuqsan karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hyperglycemia khoon mein ziyada sugar hai jo be-qaabu diabetes se hoti hai. Waqt ke saath yeh jism ke nizaam, khaas tor par nerves aur blood vessels, ko nuqsan deti hai.

book_ref.quote: over time may damage body systems, particularly nerves and blood vessels

blocks.prompt:
23 What are the effects of (i) insufficient and (ii) sufficient carbohydrate intake on the body?
(Jism par (i) kam aur (ii) kaafi carbohydrates khane ke kya asraat hain?)
blocks.explanation: (i) Kam carbohydrates thakawat aur jismani o zehni karkardagi mein kami la sakte hain. (ii) Kaafi carbohydrates hon to jism proteins ya fats todne ke bajaye inhi se energy leta hai.

book_ref.quote: On the other hand, insufficient carbohydrate intake

blocks.prompt:
24 What is the main function of fructose? What are the risks of a diet high in fructose and refined sugars?
(Fructose ka bara kaam kya hai? Ziyada fructose aur refined sugars wali khurak ke kya khatraat hain?)
blocks.explanation: Fructose metabolism mein energy deta hai. Is ka ziyada istemal motapa (jism mein ziyada fat) paida karta hai, aur ziyada refined sugars wali khurak diabetes, dil ki bimari aur kuch cancers ka khatra barhati hai; complex carbohydrates aur fibres hifazat karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Diets high in refined sugars have been associated with a higher risk of chronic diseases

blocks.prompt:
25 What are proteins? Give examples of proteins in the human body.
(Proteins kya hain? Insani jism mein proteins ki misaalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Proteins bade, complex macromolecules hain jo tamam zinda organisms mein ba-kasrat paye jate hain; mukammal hydrolysis par amino acids dete hain. Jild, baal, haemoglobin (khoon ka laal pigment) aur muscles sab proteins hain.

book_ref.quote: Proteins are large, complex macromolecules found in all living organisms abundantly.

blocks.prompt:
26 How can a wide variety of proteins be formed from amino acids?
(Amino acids se itne mukhtalif proteins kaise ban sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Taqreeban 20 mukhtalif amino acids mukhtalif tarteeb mein judte hain, is liye bohat qisam ke proteins bante hain. Protein ki banawat mein koi bhi tabdeeli jism ko ghair-maamooli bana sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: to create a wide variety of proteins

blocks.prompt:
27 What is a peptide bond? How is it formed?
(Peptide bond kya hai? Yeh kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Peptide bond aik amide bond hai jo aik amino acid ke –COO⁻ group ke saath wale amino acid ke –NH₃⁺ group se react karne par banta hai; baar baar hone se linear polymer banta hai.

book_ref.quote: group of the adjacent amino acid to form a linear polymer

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein amino group '-NH³⁺' chhapa hai; sahi –NH₃⁺ hai (book correction).

blocks.prompt:
28 What are polypeptide chains? Why are they important?
(Polypeptide chains kya hain? Yeh ahem kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se peptide linkages se bani amino acids ki lambi chains polypeptide chains hain. Har protein ki khaas polypeptide chains us ki banawat aur kaam tay karti hain.

book_ref.quote: Each protein has specific polypeptide chains, which determine its structure and function.

blocks.prompt:
29 Define the primary structure of a protein. Why is it important?
(Protein ke primary structure ki tareef karein. Yeh ahem kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Primary structure peptide bonds se judi amino acids ki khaas seedhi tarteeb hai. Yahi tarteeb tay karti hai ke protein kaise tah ho kar 3-D shakal le aur kya kaam kare; aik amino acid ki tabdeeli bhi kaam bigaad sakti hai (misaal albumin aur insulin).

book_ref.quote: Even a small change in a single amino acid can alter the protein structure

blocks.prompt:
30 What is sickle cell anemia?
(Sickle cell anemia kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh bimari hai jis mein haemoglobin ke ghalat banne se normal red blood cells darranti (sickle) jaisi shakal le leti hain. Yeh cells naaliyon ko band karti hain aur khoon ka daura bigaad deti hain.

book_ref.quote: Sickle cells clog the blood veins

blocks.prompt:
31 Differentiate between an α-helix and a β-pleated sheet.
(α-helix aur β-pleated sheet mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: α-helix aur β-pleated sheet ka muqabla, nukta ba nukta:

book_ref.quote: producing regular patterns such as α-helices and β-pleated sheets

rows: Hydrogen bonds aik hi chain ke saath bante hain
Hydrogen bonds saath wale strands ke darmiyan bante hain

blocks.prompt:
32 Why is the tertiary structure important for an enzyme?
(Enzyme ke liye tertiary structure ahem kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tertiary (3-D) structure protein ka kaam tay karta hai. Enzyme mein active site ki theek shakal substrate ko khaas tor par bandhti hai aur catalysis karti hai; is structure mein tabdeeli enzyme ki activity par asar daalti hai.

book_ref.quote: in enzymes, the precise shape of the active site allows specific binding

blocks.prompt:
33 What is the quaternary structure of a protein?
(Protein ka quaternary structure kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Quaternary structure tab banta hai jab do ya ziyada folded polypeptide chains (subunits) hydrogen bonds, ionic (salt) bridges, hydrophobic interactions aur kabhi disulphide bonds se aapas mein milti hain.

book_ref.quote: Some proteins have quaternary structures too.

blocks.prompt:
34 Differentiate between fibrous and globular proteins.
(Fibrous aur globular proteins mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Fibrous proteins aur Globular proteins ka muqabla, nukta ba nukta:

book_ref.quote: Based on the overall shape of proteins

rows: Lambe, chhari ya dhaage jaise molecules
Aam tor par na-hal, mazboot aur mustahkam
Garmi aur pH ke liye ziyada hassas

blocks.prompt:
35 What is denaturing of proteins? Give two examples.
(Proteins ki denaturing kya hai? Do misaalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Denaturing mein protein chains ke darmiyan hydrogen bonding toot jati hai aur chains khul jati hain. (i) Garam karne par anday ki safedi sakht ho jati hai. (ii) Lemon juice se pH badalne par doodh ka casein jam jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The white of an egg is hardened on heating

blocks.prompt:
36 Why do fibrous proteins serve as structural polymers?
(Fibrous proteins structural polymers ka kaam kyun karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: In ki polypeptide chains mutawazi chalti hain aur mazboot hydrogen ya disulphide bonds se fibres banati hain, is liye yeh na-hal, mazboot aur mustahkam hain, misaal collagen, keratin.

book_ref.quote: Therefore, they serve as the structural polymers.

blocks.prompt:
37 What are hormonal proteins? Give one example.
(Hormonal proteins kya hain? Aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Woh proteins jo khaas jismani activities jaise growth, development, metabolism aur reproduction ko control karte hain. Misaal: insulin, jo pancreas banata hai aur khoon se glucose ko cells mein jane ko control karta hai.

book_ref.quote: These are called Hormonal Proteins.

blocks.prompt:
38 What are storage proteins? Give an example.
(Storage proteins kya hain? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Storage proteins ugte paudon ki growth ya janwaron ki ibtidai nashonuma ke liye zaroori ghiza dete hain. Misaal: ferritin, jo kuch bacteria aur paudon o janwaron ke tissues mein iron jama karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Storage Proteins provide essential nutrients

blocks.prompt:
39 What are structural proteins? Give examples.
(Structural proteins kya hain? Misaalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Structural proteins vertebrate jism mein sab se ziyada hain; yeh fibrous hain aur shakal aur sahara dete hain, misaal baalon ka keratin, khoon ke lothre ka fibrin aur collagen. Yeh jild, ligaments, tendons aur haddiyon ka dhancha banate hain.

book_ref.quote: They are fibrous, or threadlike, which maintain the shape

blocks.prompt:
40 What are contractile proteins?
(Contractile proteins kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Contractile proteins, jaise actin aur myosin, muscle ke patle aur mote filaments banate hain aur muscle fibre ke sukadne aur phailne mein kaam aate hain.

book_ref.quote: make up the thin and thick filaments of a muscle

blocks.prompt:
41 What is the role of defensive proteins? Give an example.
(Defensive proteins ka kya kirdar hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Defensive proteins organisms ko infection se ladne aur chot se bachane mein madad dete hain. Misaal: antibodies khaas antigens (pathogens par proteins) ko pehchaan kar mazbooti se judte aur unhein khatam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Defensive proteins help organisms to fight infection

blocks.prompt:
42 What are transport proteins? Give an example.
(Transport proteins kya hain? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Transport (carrier) proteins molecules aur ions ko cell membranes ke aar paar le jane mein madad dete hain. Misaal: haemoglobin, jis mein iron oxygen se judta hai jab khoon phephron aur tissues ke darmiyan chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: as the blood travels between the lungs and the tissues

blocks.prompt:
43 Differentiate between receptor proteins and regulatory proteins.
(Receptor proteins aur regulatory proteins mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Receptor proteins aur Regulatory proteins ka muqabla, nukta ba nukta:

book_ref.quote: Receptor Proteins are located within the cell's membrane

rows: Cell membrane ke andar hote hain
Cell aur jism ki activities control karte hain
Cells se aur cells ko chemical signals wusool karte hain
Misaal: insulin, jo sugar metabolism control karta hai

blocks.prompt:
44 What are enzymes? Give one example of their speed.
(Enzymes kya hain? Un ki raftaar ki aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Enzymes proteins hain jo zinda organisms mein biological catalysts ka kaam karte hain aur reactions ko itna tez karte hain jo un ke baghair namumkin ho. Carbonic anhydrase ka aik molecule aik second mein taqreeban das lakh CO₂ aur H₂O molecules ko carbonic acid banata hai.

book_ref.quote: An enzyme speeds up a biochemical reaction to an extent that would be impossible without it.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein 'one minute' chhapa hai; sahi 'one second' hai (turnover taqreeban 10⁶ fi second) — book correction.

blocks.prompt:
45 What is the active site of an enzyme?
(Enzyme ki active site kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Active site enzyme ki satah par aik khaas jagah hai jo substrate molecule ko bandhti aur products mein badalti hai. Is ki munfarid shakal mein sirf khaas substrate fit hota hai.

book_ref.quote: An enzyme has a special site on its surface

blocks.prompt:
46 Who proposed the lock and key model? What do the lock, key and keyhole represent?
(Lock and key model kis ne pesh kiya? Taala, chaabi aur chaabi ka soorakh kis ko zahir karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Emil Fischer ne 1894 mein pesh kiya. Taala enzyme hai, chaabi substrate hai aur chaabi ka soorakh active site hai; sirf sahi shakal ki chaabi fit hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Only the correctly shaped key (substrate) fits into the keyhole

blocks.prompt:
47 One molecule of carbonic anhydrase converts about 10⁶ molecules per second. How many molecules does it convert in 2 minutes?
(Carbonic anhydrase ka aik molecule fi second taqreeban 10⁶ molecules badalta hai. 2 minute mein kitne molecules badlega?)
blocks.explanation: Waqt = 2 × 60 = 120 s. Tadaad = 10⁶ s⁻¹ × 120 s = 1.2 × 10⁸ molecules.

book_ref.quote: turnover about 10⁶ per second

blocks.prompt:
48 How is an enzyme–substrate complex formed and what happens to it?
(Enzyme–substrate complex kaise banta hai aur phir us ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Enzyme aur substrate molecules ki be-tarteeb harkat se substrate active site mein daakhil hota hai aur aarzi enzyme–substrate complex banta hai. Phir products nikal jate hain aur enzyme waisa hi reh kar agle substrate se judta hai.

book_ref.quote: The random movement of enzyme and substrate molecules

blocks.prompt:
49 Define optimum temperature and optimum pH. What happens when they are disturbed?
(Optimum temperature aur optimum pH ki tareef karein. Inhein badalne se kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jis temperature aur pH par enzyme ki activity sab se ziyada ho woh optimum temperature aur pH hain. In se hatne par enzyme ka amal ruk sakta hai. Insani enzymatic reactions 37 °C ke qareeb behtareen hote hain.

book_ref.quote: If the temperature and pH are disturbed from the optimum values

blocks.prompt:
50 Why does the rate of an enzymatic reaction increase with enzyme or substrate concentration?
(Enzyme ya substrate ki concentration barhane se enzymatic reaction ka rate kyun barhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ziyada enzyme aur substrate molecules se ziyada binding sites milti hain, ziyada enzyme-substrate complex banta hai aur rate barhta hai (substrate ki aik had tak).

book_ref.quote: This is because with more substrate and enzyme molecules

blocks.prompt:
51 Name the factors that affect enzyme activity.
(Enzyme ki activity par asar daalne wale factors ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Temperature, pH, aur substrate o enzyme ki concentration. Is ke ilawa co-enzymes, activators aur inhibitors bhi enzyme ke amal par asar daalte hain.

book_ref.quote: The important factors that influence the activity of the enzyme reaction

blocks.text: 27.3.2 Role of Inhibitors in Enzyme-Catalysed Reactions

blocks.prompt:
52 What are enzyme inhibitors?
(Enzyme inhibitors kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Inhibitors chhote molecules ya ions hain jo enzymes ki catalytic activity khatam kar dete hain. Mukhtalif inhibitors ka tareeqa alag hai magar sab active site ko substrate se judne se rokte hain.

book_ref.quote: Although, different inhibitors behave differently

blocks.prompt:
53 Why are reversible inhibitors also called competitive inhibitors?
(Reversible inhibitors ko competitive inhibitors kyun bhi kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Un ki shakal substrate jaisi hai, is liye substrate aur inhibitor active site ke liye muqabla karte hain; jitna ziyada inhibitor, utna enzyme substrate ke liye be-asar. Yeh non-covalent bonds se judte hain.

book_ref.quote: The substrate and the inhibitor compete for the active site of the enzyme.

blocks.prompt:
54 How does malonate inhibit the enzyme succinate dehydrogenase?
(Malonate succinate dehydrogenase enzyme ko kaise rokta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Succinate dehydrogenase butanedioate (succinate, ⁻OOC–CH₂–CH₂–COO⁻) ko oxidise karta hai. Propanedioate (malonate, ⁻OOC–CH₂–COO⁻) is jaisa hai, active site ke liye muqabla karta aur enzyme ko rokta hai.

book_ref.quote: the substrate butanedioate (succinate ion) is oxidized

blocks.prompt:
55 How does penicillin kill bacteria?
(Penicillin bacteria ko kaise maarta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Penicillin irreversible inhibitor hai jo trans-peptidase enzyme ko rokta hai; yeh enzyme bacteria ki cell wall banata hai. Is enzyme ke rukne se bacteria mar jate hain.

book_ref.quote: This enzyme acts for the synthesis of the bacterial cell wall.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein aakhri jumle mein 'insulin' chhapa hai; bacteria ko penicillin maarta hai, insulin nahi (book correction).

blocks.prompt:
56 Why can irreversible inhibition be dangerous? Name substances that act as irreversible inhibitors.
(Irreversible inhibition khatarnaak kyun ho sakti hai? Irreversible inhibitors ka kaam karne wale substances ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Irreversible inhibitors active site ki shakal badal dete hain aur substrate ke liye jagah nahi rehti; enzyme hamesha ke liye be-asar ho jata hai jo sehat ke sangeen masail ya maut ka sabab ban sakta hai. Misaalein: zehar, antibiotics, anti-metabolites aur kuch dawaiyan.

book_ref.quote: it sometimes causes severe human health issues or even death

blocks.prompt:
57 How does cobra venom cause hemolysis?
(Cobra ka zehar hemolysis kaise karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cobra ke zehar mein PLA2 (phospholipase A2) enzyme hai jo red blood cell ki membrane ke phospholipids todta hai. Is se hemolysis, mutasira uzw ki sojan aur aakhir maut hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: which causes swelling of the affected organ

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein 'cell wall' likha hai, magar red blood cell ki cell wall nahi hoti; PLA2 membrane ke phospholipids todta hai (book correction).

blocks.prompt:
58 What are lipids? How do they differ from polysaccharides and proteins?
(Lipids kya hain? Yeh polysaccharides aur proteins se kaise mukhtalif hain?)
blocks.explanation: Lipids janwaron aur paudon ke organic compounds hain jin mein fats, phospholipids, steroids aur terpenes shamil hain; yeh hydrophobic hain magar organic solvents mein hal hote hain. Polysaccharides aur proteins ke bar-aks lipids polymers nahi; un mein dohrane wala monomer unit nahi.

book_ref.quote: Unlike, polysaccharides and proteins

blocks.prompt:
59 List the functions of lipids in living systems.
(Zinda nizaam mein lipids ke kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Lipids fuel molecules, signal molecules, membranes ke hisse, hormones aur cell ke andar paigham-rasaan ka kaam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: as fuel molecules, signal molecules, components of membranes

blocks.prompt:
60 What are triglycerides? Give their importance.
(Triglycerides kya hain? Un ki ahmiyat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Triglycerides (janwaron ki fats aur sabzi ke oils) aik glycerol molecule aur teen fatty acids ke esters hain; fatty acids aik jaise ya mukhtalif ho sakte hain. Yeh energy jama karne ke behtareen molecules hain aur insulation, aaza ki hifazat aur fat mein hal vitamins ka zariya bhi hain.

book_ref.quote: This structure makes them efficient energy storage molecules

blocks.prompt:
61 How does the hydrophobic nature of fats help the body?
(Fats ki hydrophobic fitrat jism ki kaise madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrophobic fatty acid chains fats ko paani mein na-hal banati hain. Is liye fats jild ke neeche insulating teh aur gurdon jaise aaza ke gird gadda banate hain, jo temperature control aur hifazat mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: In the body, this property allows them to form insulating layers under the skin

blocks.prompt:
62 What are waxes? Why do they form protective coatings? Give two natural examples.
(Waxes kya hain? Yeh hifazati teh kyun banate hain? Do qudrati misaalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Waxes lambi fatty acid chains aur lambi chain wale alcohols ke esters hain. Dono chains non-polar aur hydrophobic hain, is liye wax aisi teh banata hai jis par paani nahi chipakta. Misaalein: beeswax, paudon ka wax (aur kuch aabi parindon ke par).

book_ref.quote: Both chains are nonpolar and hydrophobic (water-repelling).

blocks.prompt:
63 Give the industrial uses of waxes.
(Waxes ke sannati istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Waxes pharmaceutical, cosmetic aur doosri industries mein lotions, ointments aur polishes banane mein ba-kasrat istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: These are widely used in pharmaceutical, cosmetic and other industries

blocks.prompt:
64 What are compound lipids? Name three types.
(Compound lipids kya hain? Teen qismon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Compound lipids fatty acids aur aise alcohols ke esters hain jin mein aik izaafi group (phosphate, nitrogenous base, carbohydrate ya protein) ho. Qismein: phospholipids, lipoproteins aur glycolipids.

book_ref.quote: These are esters of fatty acids with alcohols containing an additional group

blocks.prompt:
65 Differentiate between a fat (triglyceride) and a phospholipid.
(Fat (triglyceride) aur phospholipid mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Fat (triglyceride) aur Phospholipid ka muqabla, nukta ba nukta:

book_ref.quote: A phospholipid is similar to a fat molecule

rows: Glycerol ka teesra –OH phosphate group se juda
Hydrophilic polar sir aur hydrophobic dumein
Cell membranes ki bilayer banata hai

blocks.prompt:
66 What is a phospholipid bilayer?
(Phospholipid bilayer kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab phospholipids paani mein daale jayen to do tehon wali sheet, bilayer, banti hai: polar sir bahar aur non-polar dumein andar ikatthi hoti hain. Yahi tamam cell membranes ki banawat hai.

book_ref.quote: When phospholipids are added to water

blocks.prompt:
67 Why are liposomes used to deliver water-soluble cancer drugs?
(Paani mein hal hone wali cancer dawaiyan pohanchane ke liye liposomes kyun istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Liposome aik lipid bilayer hai jo paani wale markaz ko gherti hai, is liye paani mein hal dawa ko andar band kar ke tootne se bachati aur cell mein daakhil karwati hai. Liposomes solubility barhate aur dawa seedhi tumour cells tak pohanchate hain.

book_ref.quote: They improve solubility, provide targeted delivery to the tumor cells.

blocks.prompt:
68 What are derived lipids? Give examples and their roles.
(Derived lipids kya hain? Misaalein aur un ke kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Derived lipids simple aur compound lipids ki hydrolysis ke products hain jin mein lipid ki khasusiyaat hain, misaal fatty acids, glycerol, steroids aur lipid mein hal vitamins. Yeh khud fats nahi magar fats se bante hain; energy, hormones, cell ki banawat, nerves aur vitamins ke kaam mein madad dete hain.

book_ref.quote: They are not fats themselves, but come from fats.

blocks.prompt:
69 What are sterols? Name four steroids found in biological systems.
(Sterols kya hain? Biological nizaam mein paye jane wale chaar steroids ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Jin steroids mein –OH functional group ho woh alcohol class mein aate hain aur sterols kehlate hain. Biological steroids: cholesterol, bile salts, vitamin D aur steroid hormones.

book_ref.quote: Many steroids also have the –OH functional group

blocks.prompt:
70 What are terpenes? Which terpenes are called carotenoids?
(Terpenes kya hain? Kaun se terpenes carotenoids kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Terpenes paudon mein maujood hydrocarbons (essential oils) hain jo isoprene units, CH₂=C(CH₃)–CH=CH₂ (C₅H₈), se bante hain. 40 carbon atoms wale terpenes carotenoids kehlate hain.

book_ref.quote: Lipids present in plants include a wide variety of hydrocarbons called terpenes

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ka chhapa hua isoprene formula ghalat hai; sahi CH₂=C(CH₃)–CH=CH₂ hai (book correction).

blocks.prompt:
71 A terpene contains 30 carbon atoms. How many isoprene (C₅H₈) units build its carbon skeleton? Is it a carotenoid?
(Aik terpene mein 30 carbon atoms hain. Is ka carbon dhancha kitne isoprene (C₅H₈) units se bana hai? Kya yeh carotenoid hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har isoprene unit mein 5 C atoms: units = 30 ÷ 5 = 6. Yeh carotenoid nahi, kyun ke carotenoids 40 carbon atoms (8 units) wale terpenes hain.

book_ref.quote: Terpenes that contain 40 carbon atoms are known as carotenoids.

blocks.text: 27.4.4 Nutritional and Biological Importance of Lipids

blocks.prompt:
72 Why are lipids a better energy store than carbohydrates?
(Lipids carbohydrates se behtar energy zakheera kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Lipids zinda organisms mein energy ka bunyaadi zakheera hain. Carbon dioxide aur paani tak oxidise hone par un ki caloric value ziyada hai, is liye yeh carbohydrates se fi gram ziyada energy dete hain.

book_ref.quote: A major function of lipids is to serve as a primary source of energy storage

blocks.prompt:
73 Why should vitamins A, D, E and K be eaten with a little healthy fat?
(Vitamins A, D, E aur K thodi sehatmand fat ke saath kyun khane chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh fat mein hal hone wale vitamins hain. Lipids in ke liye solvent ka kaam karte aur aanton ke cells aur phir khoon mein jazb karwate hain, is liye thodi fat in ke jazb mein madad deti hai.

book_ref.quote: These vitamins should be eaten with a bit of healthy fat.

blocks.prompt:
74 Why do animals store extra fat before hibernation?
(Janwar hibernation se pehle ziyada fat kyun jama karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Hibernation mein janwar khurak ki kami ke waqt energy bachane ke liye metabolic rate, jism ka temperature, dil ki dhadkan aur saans bohat kam kar dete hain. Fat glycogen se ziyada concentrated energy hai, is liye jama fat kam kharch mein behtar kaam aata hai.

book_ref.quote: store extra fat when hibernating

blocks.prompt:
75 What are nucleic acids? Which sugars do they contain?
(Nucleic acids kya hain? Un mein kaun si sugars hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleic acids bade biomolecules hain jo genetic maloomat jama aur muntaqil karte hain; yeh nucleotides ke polymers hain (baari baari sugar aur phosphate groups, sugar se bases jude). RNA mein ribose aur DNA mein deoxyribose sugar hai.

book_ref.quote: Nucleic acids are large biomolecules that store and transmit genetic information.

blocks.prompt:
76 How is a polynucleotide chain formed? Why is it strong?
(Polynucleotide chain kaise banti hai? Yeh mazboot kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleotides sugar ke 5' aur 3' carbon atoms ke zariye phosphodiester linkages se judte hain; yeh kai million baar dohraya jata hai to polynucleotide banta hai. Phosphodiester linkages mazboot covalent bonds hain jo mazbooti aur istehkaam dete hain.

book_ref.quote: The process is repeated up to several million times to make a polynucleotide.

blocks.prompt:
77 What is a gene?
(Gene kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Genes DNA ke khaas hisse hain jo genetic maloomat rakhte hain. Yeh cell ko khaas protein banane ki hidayat dete hain; har khaas protein aik khaas gene se banta hai.

book_ref.quote: Genes are the specific regions of DNA that carry genetic information.

blocks.prompt:
78 What are chromosomes? How many do humans receive from their parents?
(Chromosomes kya hain? Insan waldain se kitne paate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Genes bade units mein munazzam hain jinhein chromosomes kehte hain. Insan waldain se chromosomes ke 23 jode paate hain aur taqreeban har cell mein poore 23 jode hote hain.

book_ref.quote: These genes are organised into larger units called chromosomes

blocks.prompt:
79 Every cell carries the full set of genes. Why, then, does a red blood cell make haemoglobin but not keratin?
(Har cell mein genes ka poora set hai. Phir red blood cell haemoglobin kyun banata hai magar keratin nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Har qisam ka cell sirf woh khaas genes chalu karta hai jin ki use zaroorat hai. Red blood cell haemoglobin ka gene chalu aur keratin ka gene band rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: while keeping the gene for keratin switched off

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ka jumla 'each cell is a different specific pectine' ghalat chhapa hai; matlab yeh hai ke har cell sirf apne zaroori genes chalu karta hai (book correction).

blocks.prompt:
80 One strand of DNA reads G-T-A-C-C-T. Write the opposite strand and find the number of hydrogen bonds holding this segment.
(DNA ke aik strand par G-T-A-C-C-T hai. Saamne wala strand likhein aur is hisse ko jodne wale hydrogen bonds ki tadaad maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: A ka jora T, G ka C: saamne wala strand C-A-T-G-G-A. G–C jode: G, C, C = 3 × 3 = 9; A–T jode: T, A, T = 3 × 2 = 6; kul = 15 hydrogen bonds.

book_ref.quote: Adenine (A) is always opposite to thymine (T)

blocks.prompt:
81 What is replication? Why is it important?
(Replication kya hai? Yeh ahem kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Replication cell cycle ka woh process hai jis mein DNA ki naqal banti hai taake cell taqseem ho to har naye cell ko genetic material ka poora set mile. Is tarah genetic maloomat beti cells aur agli nasal tak pohanchti hai.

book_ref.quote: In this way, the genetic information is transmitted from one cell to the daughter cells

blocks.prompt:
82 Why are the two chains of DNA said to be opposite (not identical) to each other?
(DNA ki do chains ko aik doosre ki ulat (aik jaisi nahi) kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Base pairing (A ke saamne T, G ke saamne C) ki wajah se chains aik jaisi nahi balke takmeeli (complementary) hain aur ulat chalti hain: aik ka 3' sira doosri ke 5' sire ke saamne hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The two polynucleotide chains are not identical but opposite to each other due to base pairing

blocks.prompt:
83 Differentiate between DNA and RNA in structure.
(Banawat ke lehaaz se DNA aur RNA mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: DNA aur RNA ka muqabla, nukta ba nukta:

book_ref.quote: A ribonucleotide chain in the RNA contains ribose

rows: Aam tor par aik strand; mud kar helical loop bana sakta hai

blocks.text: 27.5.3 The Genetic Code and Protein Synthesis

blocks.prompt:
84 Differentiate between transcription and translation.
(Transcription aur translation mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Transcription aur Translation ka muqabla, nukta ba nukta:

book_ref.quote: Protein synthesis is a complex process involved in transferring genetic information encoded in the DNA.

rows: DNA gene ki hidayaat mRNA mein naqal hoti hain
mRNA ka code parh kar amino acids ki tarteeb banai jati hai
Nucleus mein DNA par hota hai
Cytoplasm mein ribosomes par hota hai

blocks.prompt:
85 How is the polypeptide chain built at the ribosome?
(Ribosome par polypeptide chain kaise banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amino acids mRNA ke bases ki tarteeb ke mutabiq lagte hain. tRNA molecules apne amino acids chhodte hain jo chain mein judte hain; amino acids ke darmiyan bonds banne se polypeptide barhti hai aur aakhir mukammal protein banta hai.

book_ref.quote: The tRNA molecules release their amino acids

blocks.prompt:
86 Differentiate between macro-minerals and micro-minerals.
(Macro-minerals aur micro-minerals mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Macro (major) minerals aur Micro (trace) minerals ka muqabla, nukta ba nukta:

book_ref.quote: Minerals may be broadly classified as macro (major) or micro (trace) elements.

rows: Rozana taqreeban 100 mg se ziyada chahiye
Rozana taqreeban 100 mg se kam chahiye
Calcium, phosphorus, sodium, chloride, potassium, magnesium, sulfur
Iron, copper, cobalt, iodine, zinc, manganese, molybdenum, fluoride, chromium, selenium

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein potassium, magnesium aur sulfur micro list mein aur had '100 mg/dL' likhi hai; book correction ke mutabiq yeh teen macro hain aur had taqreeban 100 mg rozana hai.

blocks.prompt:
87 Give the role of calcium in nutrition and two of its sources.
(Ghiza mein calcium ka kirdar aur is ke do zariye likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Calcium haddiyan aur daant banane, khoon ke theek jamne, muscles ke sukadne aur phailne, dil aur nerves ke kaam mein madad deta hai. Zariye: doodh aur dairy, hari sabziyan, broccoli, salmon, sardines, phaliyan.

book_ref.quote: Helps in the formation of bones and teeth, normal blood clotting

blocks.prompt:
88 What is the role of phosphorus in the body?
(Jism mein phosphorus ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phosphorus haddiyan aur daant banane mein madad deta, jism ki energy (ATP) ke nikalne aur istemal ko control karta, phospholipids ka hissa ban kar fat le jata aur jism ka acid/base tawazun theek rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: It helps to carry fat in the body as a part of phospholipids.

blocks.prompt:
89 What is the role of zinc in the body? Name its sources.
(Jism mein zinc ka kya kirdar hai? Is ke zariye batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Zinc bohat se enzyme systems ka hissa hai, misaal growth aur immune function wale, aur insulin hormone mein paya jata hai. Zariye: gosht, samandari khurak aur saabut anaaj.

book_ref.quote: Component of many enzyme systems

blocks.prompt:
90 What is the role of sodium, potassium and chloride in the body?
(Jism mein sodium, potassium aur chloride ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sodium, potassium aur chloride fluid balance, nerves ke paigham aur muscles ke kaam ko theek rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: Maintaining fluid balance, nerve transmission
